reason: Honestly my friends' WhatsApp group already tells me every deadline, even if it's the night before, and the portal works fine when I actually need it. I might install it if someone sends the link, but I'd mute the alerts and forget it by week two.
objection: It's just another app with notifications I'll ignore. WhatsApp is where I already am, so why would I open a separate feed?
would_change_my_mind: If my whole friend group started using it and the alerts actually saved me from missing a submission at least once, so it beats hearing it from friends.
